subject: Emotions
title: Oxytocin and Bonding Joy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Oxytocin and Bonding Joy.

hook.text: A mother holds her newborn and feels an overwhelming wave of love. Oxytocin surges in both their brains at once.

buildup.text: Oxytocin is released during touch, eye contact, trust, and sex. It's called the 'love hormone' for a reason.

discovery.text: Prairie voles given oxytocin bond for life. Block it and they become promiscuous. One molecule decides everything.

twist.text: Oxytocin has a dark side. It bonds you to your group but makes you hostile to outsiders. Love and bias share a molecule.

climax.text: The deepest joys—love, friendship, community—all run on oxytocin. Social bonds are chemical bonds.

punchline.text: Connection isn't just a feeling. It's a chemical event.

quiz.question: What is the dark side of oxytocin?
